unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U20: Apply exclusions,closed-court rules and sufficient-cause relief within their scope

payload.title: An exclusion changes computation only when its conditions exist
payload.core_explanation_md:
The source identifies separate rules for a court closed on the last day, exclusion of the starting day, qualifying copy-preparation time, stays and required notice or sanction periods. Keep their facts and authority in the calculation record. An office closure at the bank is not automatically the court-closure rule.

Section5 sufficient-cause relief has a defined scope; it should not be advertised as a general power to forgive every late suit. Nor is a request for condonation already a granted extension. First calculate the ordinary period, then apply only supported exclusions or relief under the proper provision and order.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every delay become excused when the bank records a reason?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The applicable rule and competent decision must support the relief.

payload.stem_md: A branch holiday is treated as proof that a court was closed on the final filing day. What must be established?

options.text_md: The actual court calendar and applicable closure rule
options.explanation_md: Branch and court operating days can differ.
It does not establish the court status.
Pricing does not determine court closure.

options.text_md: The borrower agrees that every day is excluded
options.explanation_md: A private preference is not the legal computation rule.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Branch and court operating days can differ.

payload.stem_md: A late suit is defended only by saying section 5 always excuses any late proceeding. Which issue is missing?

options.text_md: Every suit is an appeal by definition
A private explanation is automatically a court order
options.explanation_md: Relief requires the applicable legal process.

options.text_md: The provision scope and whether that proceeding can use it
options.explanation_md: The source does not provide universal suit condonation.

options.text_md: Only the size of the original advance
options.explanation_md: Claim size alone does not settle condonation power.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source does not provide universal suit condonation.
